/* InptResultAnalyMapper.selectRefList */
SELECT refNO, refCnt, COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN ext != '미추출' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHUCHUL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN hand != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SUGI_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN hand != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN (ext != '미추출' AND (hand = '.' OR hand = '-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN (ext = hand OR (ext='++' AND hand != ' ')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OH_DAP, SUM(CASE WHEN (ext = '미추출' AND hand != ' ') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOP_CHUCHUL, SUM(CASE WHEN (ext != '미추출' AND (hand = '.' OR hand = '-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KWA_TAM, SUM(CASE WHEN (ext = hand OR (ext='++' AND hand != ' ')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MISS_SUGI FROM( SELECT T1.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS refNO , T1.FX_REFNO_SRNO AS refCnt , T2.INPT_BL_GRP_NO AS 그룹 , T1.AI_INSPE_ENO AS 심사자 , ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(T1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, '1', '240', '230') AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = TO_CHAR(T3.INPT_SANCTION_NO) ) AS 항목명, NVL(DECODE(T3.ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN, 'U', NULL, T3.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT),'미추출') AS ext, --수정 NVL(T3.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT,' ') AS hand, T3.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS 변경시간, T1.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AS 상태 FROM CSPD001TM T1, CSPD002TG T2, CSPD004TF T3 WHERE SUBSTR(T1.INPT_RCP_DT,0,8) = #{schSdate} AND T2.INPT_MST_SRNO = T1.INPT_MST_SRNO AND T3.INPT_MST_SRNO = T2.INPT_MST_SRNO AND T3.INPT_TASK_ID = T2.INPT_TASK_ID AND T3.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND TO_NUMBER(T1.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) >= 140 AND T3.INPT_SANCTION_NO != '88' ORDER BY T1.INPT_MST_SRNO, T2.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, T3.INPT_SANCTION_NO ) T4 GROUP BY refNO, refCnt

/* InptResultAnalyMapper.selectCategoryList */
SELECT name, count(*) AS TOT_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN ext != '미추출' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHUCHUL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN hand != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SUGI_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN hand != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -SUM(CASE WHEN (ext != '미추출' AND (hand = '.' OR hand = '-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -SUM(CASE WHEN (ext = hand OR (ext='++' AND hand != ' ')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OH_DAP, SUM(CASE WHEN (ext = '미추출' AND hand != ' ') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOP_CHUCHUL, SUM(CASE WHEN (ext != '미추출' AND (hand = '.' OR hand = '-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KWA_TAM, SUM(CASE WHEN (ext = hand OR (ext='++' AND hand != ' ')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MISS_SUGI FROM( SELECT T1.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS refNO, T1.FX_REFNO_SRNO AS 회차, T2.INPT_BL_GRP_NO AS 그룹, T1.AI_INSPE_ENO AS 심사자, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(T1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, '1', '240', '230') AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = TO_CHAR(T3.INPT_SANCTION_NO) ) AS name,
NVL(DECODE(T3.ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN, 'U', NULL, T3.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT),'미추출') AS ext, --수정 NVL(T3.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT,' ') AS hand, T3.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS 변경시간, T1.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AS 상태 FROM CSPD001TM T1 , CSPD002TG T2 , CSPD004TF T3 WHERE SUBSTR(T1.INPT_RCP_DT,0,8) = #{schSdate} AND T2.INPT_MST_SRNO = T1.INPT_MST_SRNO AND T3.INPT_MST_SRNO = T2.INPT_MST_SRNO AND T3.INPT_TASK_ID = T2.INPT_TASK_ID AND T3.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND TO_NUMBER(T1.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) >= 140 AND T3.INPT_SANCTION_NO != '88' ORDER BY T1.INPT_MST_SRNO, T2.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, T3.INPT_SANCTION_NO ) T4
GROUP BY name

/* InptResultAnalyMapper.selectPerformanceList */
SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.IMG_PG AS IMG_PG , A.SCAN_TM AS SCAN_TM , A.TA_TM AS TA_TM , ROUND((TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.TA_TM,1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.SCAN_TM,1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) * 24 * 60 ,0) AS RST_MIN , ROUND((TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.TA_TM,1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.SCAN_TM,1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) * 24 * 60 * 60,0) AS RST_SEC FROM ( SELECT M.INPT_MST_SRNO , M.ACTL_FX_REFNO , M.FX_REFNO_SRNO , (SELECT MIN(LST_DB_CHG_DTM) FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD in ( '20','21') ) AS SCAN_TM , (SELECT MIN(LST_DB_CHG_DTM) FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '40' AND AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT = '항목_심사' ) AS TA_TM , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CSPD002TG WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS IMG_PG FROM CSPD001TM M WHERE M.INPT_RCP_DT = #{schSdate} AND M.PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL AND M.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('160','140') ) A ORDER BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO

/* InptResultAnalyMapper."selectDailyPerformList" */
SELECT x.*, --추출정확도 = ROUND(추출항목수 - 수기입력수 + 미추출건수 + 수기건오류수 ) / (추출항목수 + 미추출건수) * 100, 1) CASE WHEN (CHUCHUL_CNT + NOP_CHUCHUL_CNT) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((CHUCHUL_CNT - SUGI_CNT + NOP_CHUCHUL_CNT + SUGI_ERR_CNT) / (CHUCHUL_CNT + NOP_CHUCHUL_CNT) * 100, 1) END AS EXT_RT --추출정확도(%) FROM ( SELECT REPLACE(#{schSdate},'-','') AS SCH_DATE, biz_nm AS BIZ_NAME, -- 구분 name AS H_NAME, -- 항목명 sort_seq, count(*) AS TOT_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN ext_value != '미추출' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CHUCHUL_CNT, --추출항목수 SUM(CASE WHEN hnd_value != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SUGI_CNT, --수기입력수 SUM(CASE WHEN hnd_value != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -SUM(CASE WHEN (ext_value != '미추출' AND (hnd_value = '.' OR hnd_value = '-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -SUM(CASE WHEN (ext_value = hnd_value OR (ext_value='++' AND hnd_value != ' ')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OH_DAP, --오답 SUM(CASE WHEN (ext_value = '미추출' AND hnd_value != ' ') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOP_CHUCHUL_CNT, --미추출 SUM(CASE WHEN (ext_value != '미추출' AND (hnd_value = '.' OR hnd_value = '-')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KWA_TAM, --과탐 SUM(CASE WHEN (ext_value = hnd_value OR (ext_value='++' AND hnd_value != ' ')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SUGI_ERR_CNT --수기오류 FROM( SELECT T1.ACTL_FX_REFNO, T1.FX_REFNO_SRNO, CASE WHEN T1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN '수입' ELSE '수출' END AS biz_nm, T2.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, T4.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS name, T4.AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ AS sort_seq, NVL(T3.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT,'미추출') AS ext_value, NVL(T3.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT,' ') AS hnd_value FROM CSPD001TM T1 , CSPD002TG T2 , CSPD004TF T3 , CSPD112TI T4 WHERE T1.INPT_RCP_DT = #{schSdate} AND T1.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140','160') AND T2.INPT_MST_SRNO = T1.INPT_MST_SRNO AND T3.INPT_MST_SRNO = T2.INPT_MST_SRNO AND T3.INPT_TASK_ID = T2.INPT_TASK_ID AND T3.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND T4.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(T1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, '1', '904' ,'2', '903') AND T4.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = TO_CHAR(T3.INPT_SANCTION_NO) AND T4.AI_INPT_CMN_USG_YN = 'Y' AND T4.AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM = 'IN' ) GROUP BY biz_nm, sort_seq, name ) X
